ab.title: Book narration
ab.f5Desc: Потоковый мэтчинг: быстро, стабильно, без зацикливания слов.
ab.xttsDesc: Авторегрессионный GPT: глубокая эмоция и драматические паузы.
ab.gpuNotFound: NVIDIA GPU не обнаружен — рендер на CUDA невозможен.
ab.expressNote: Smart Express: авто-конфиг под вашу карту ({precision}).
ab.envNotFound: Interpreter "{{cmd}}" was not found or failed to start. Set the correct path in Settings → Voice (Python interpreter).
ab.envMissing: Modules required by the selected engine are missing: {{modules}}.
ab.envInstallHint: Install them into that exact interpreter:
ab.envSettingsHint: If the modules live in another environment, set its python path in Settings → Voice.
ab.tipPrecision: Влияет на: качество звука и потребление VRAM. FP16 вдвое снижает VRAM на 8-гигабайтных картах без потери качества. Слишком высоко (FP32): риск Out-Of-Memory на длинных главах. Слишком низко (INT8): деградация тембра.
ab.tipAttention: Влияет на: скорость трансформера и пики VRAM. FlashAttention-2/SDPA убирают всплески памяти на длинных батчах. Eager: медленно и рискованно по VRAM.
ab.tipVramGc: torch.cuda.empty_cache() после чанков возвращает неиспользуемую VRAM системе, предотвращая утечки при многочасовых рендерах.
ab.tipNfe: Шаги ODE-солвера при flow matching. Ниже 20 — глухой шипящий фон; выше 60 — резко медленнее без слышимого выигрыша.
ab.tipCfg: Насколько строго модель держится референсного голоса. Выше 4 — искажения и клиппинг; ниже 1.5 — теряется личность голоса.
ab.tipSolver: Математический метод реконструкции волны. Euler — лучшая скорость на CUDA; RK4 точнее, но медленнее.
ab.tipExaggeration: Эмоциональная вариативность F5-TTS. Выше 1.5 — неестественные выкрики; ниже — монотонное чтение.
ab.tipTemperature: Выше — эмоциональнее, но риск смазанных слов; ниже — монотонно. Оптимум для русского: 0.65–0.75.
ab.tipRepPenalty: Критично для русского: не даёт модели залипать на повторах гласных («а-а-а-а»). Выше 7 — ломаются слова; ниже — зацикливание.
ab.tipTopK: Фильтр кандидатов-токенов по количеству. Ниже — предсказуемее, выше — разнообразнее, но больше артефактов.
ab.tipTopP: Ядровая фильтрация фонемных токенов. 0.85 срезает неестественный «хвост» распределения, сохраняя связность речи.
ab.tipExpandNumbers: Преобразует цифры и символы в проговариваемые слова («2026» → «две тысячи двадцать шестой»).
ab.tipYoficate: Восстанавливает «ё» («еще» → «ещё») — предотвращает неправильное произношение и ошибки ударения.
ab.tipMarkStress: RUAccent расставляет ударения по смыслу фразы («за́мок» — крепость или «замо́к» — запор, «му́ка» или «мука́») и восстанавливает «ё». Ставится вместе с окружением озвучки; при первом задании качает ~80 МБ моделей.
ab.tipCrossFade: Плавно смешивает стыки между чанками, убирая щелчки. Выше 200 мс — смазанные переходы; ниже — щелчки и popping.
ab.tipSentencePause: Тишина на точке, восклицательном и вопросительном знаке.
ab.tipParagraphPause: Тишина между абзацами и разделами книги.

bypass.ksHint: When armed, if the proxy core drops, ALL outbound traffic is blocked via a real Windows Firewall rule — until you manually disarm it. It can only be lifted with the "Disarm" button below (intentional: silent auto-recovery would defeat the point of a kill-switch). Each arm/disarm triggers a UAC prompt. The rule does not survive an app restart — it's removed automatically on the next launch.

up.title: Photo & video upscale
up.drop: Drop a photo or video here
up.dropHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM
up.empty: Pick a photo or video to start upscaling
up.modelNoneNote: Upscaling is off: frames pass through as they are, only interpolation and re-encoding run.
up.modelNoneHint: The upscale model is not used at all: handy when the resolution is already enough and you only need a higher frame rate (or a re-encode).
up.noModels: Model catalog is empty — check server/models.manifest.json
up.noPresets: No presets for this media type
up.proHint: Tiling for big frames, inference provider, denoise/sharpen, model blending.
up.scaleHint: The model runs at its own factor, then ffmpeg resizes to the chosen one.
up.interpModeHint: minterpolate works as soon as FFmpeg is installed, no models needed; ONNX models (RIFE/CAIN) come later.
up.interpModelHint: RIFE/CAIN interpolate frames with a neural network: much smoother but slower — on CPU it is a few frames per second, CUDA/DirectML recommended.
up.interpMultModelHint: RIFE and IFRNet accept a time step, so ×3 and ×4 are computed directly, without cascades. CAIN interpolates only the middle of a pair, so only ×2 is available for it.
up.interpNoModel: No interpolator found in the manifest
up.interpModelNeedsDownload: Interpolator is not downloaded — open Pro settings → “ONNX models”
up.interpMultHint: ×2 turns 30 fps into 60 and 25 into 50. Audio and subtitles are copied without re-encoding.
up.minterpModeHint: mci — motion estimation (best quality, highest cost), blend — frame blending (fast, ghosts in motion), dup — duplicate frames.
up.minterpSideHint: Before upscale — the interpolator works on the source frames and the upscaler processes 2–4× more frames (cheaper interpolation, more expensive upscale). After upscale — the other way round: the upscaler handles the source frames, the interpolator handles the enlarged ones. With ONNX models (RIFE/CAIN) the after-upscale order is noticeably faster overall.
up.sceneCutHint: On cuts frames are duplicated instead of interpolated — otherwise motion shows doubles.
up.targetSizeHint: 0 — use the factor. Set one side — the other follows the aspect.
up.formatHint: PNG is lossless; the rest use quality.
up.tileHint: Smaller tiles use less VRAM/RAM but run slower.
up.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg not found — install it from the Converter page.
up.runtimeMissing: Embedded ONNX runtime (onnxruntime-node) is missing. Install dependencies:
up.denoiseHint: hqdn3d before upscale — removes noise and artifacts.
up.blendModelHint: Both model outputs are blended — softer textures.
up.hwAccelHint: Encode and decode on the GPU when the ffmpeg build supports it (hardware encoder and decoder). Disabled, everything runs on the CPU: more compatible but slower. It also picks the encoder: without acceleration AV1 goes through SVT-AV1/AOM instead of NVENC.
up.audioHint: Lossless copy or re-encode to AAC.
up.err_interp_model_missing: Interpolation model not found — download it in Pro settings.
up.err_model_signature_unknown: Model input signature not recognised (RIFE, CAIN or IFRNet expected).
up.err_interp_output_missing: The interpolation model returned no frame.
up.err_interp_frame_count: The model returned a wrong number of intermediate frames.
up.err_vcodec_unavailable: This ffmpeg build has no encoder for the selected codec
up.expressHint: Quick controls: model, factor and format/codec
up.slowMotionHint: Stretches the finished video: 0.5× — twice slower, 0.25× — four times. Audio is slowed with the picture (the track is re-encoded).
up.batchFramesHint: How many frames to run through ONNX at once. Auto picks the size from free GPU memory — the fastest safe option; manually you can choose 1…128. If the batch does not fit in memory or the model does not support it, processing falls back to a smaller batch or one-by-one.
up.frameLimitHint: Process only the first N frames: quick settings check on a video snippet.
up.mdlOpenHint: Model catalog: downloads, categories and optimal settings
up.mdlRemoveHint: Free up space: the file is deleted from disk
up.mdlErr_model_unknown: no such model in the catalog
up.mdlErr_model_no_url: this model has no download URL
up.mdlErrNet: network is unavailable or the download was interrupted
up.apiDown: The upscale API is not responding — check that the server is running and retry
up.mdlSyncHint: Download the fresh model list from GitHub — no app update needed
up.mdlDownloadAllHint: Download every model file in the catalog — one by one, with progress
up.mdlDeleteAllConfirm: Delete files of all downloaded models? Space is freed and models can be downloaded again.
up.mdlSrcBundled: Built-in catalog — press “Update catalog” to get the fresh model list
up.mdlErr_manifest_fetch: Could not fetch the catalog from GitHub: no connection or the address is unavailable. The catalog was not changed
up.mdlErr_manifest_invalid: The catalog address does not contain a model manifest (file is broken or the address/branch changed)
up.mdlErr_manifest_empty: The received catalog has no usable models — it was not changed
up.mdlErr_manifest_too_big: Catalog file is too large — download cancelled
up.mdlErr_timeout: GitHub did not answer in time — try again
up.mdlErr_zip_no_onnx: The archive has no ONNX model — the link points to the wrong file
up.mdlErr_zip_invalid: The archive is broken or in an unknown format — download cancelled
up.cmpHint: Wheel to zoom, drag to pan, the bar compares
up.batchHint: Files go to the queue one by one with the current settings. Progress is per file.
up.batchSingleHint: This model accepts exactly one frame per pass (batch=1 in its ONNX graph), so there is no batching for it: frames stream one by one. That keeps the GPU busy between passes and avoids holding extra memory. Pick a model marked with a batch in the catalog to get the setting back.
up.interpBatchHint: How many tiles of a pair to compute in one ONNX pass. More — fewer call overheads, but more memory. Auto uses up to 4 tiles. Only works for models whose graph accepts a batch.
up.interpBatchSingleHint: This interpolator has a fixed batch=1 graph: tiles of a pair are computed one by one, so the tile batch does not apply.
up.mdlBatchAutoHint: The catalog does not know this model's batch limit — the engine picks it itself (up to 8 frames per pass). Press “Benchmark” to find the exact value on this machine.
up.mdlAlignHint: The graph accepts only aligned sides (Real-CUGAN); the engine pads the tile and crops the result.
up.mdlTrtHint: Building a TensorRT engine takes minutes and speeds the model up on NVIDIA GPUs: ONNX Runtime compiles the graph for the GPU and then loads the ready engine from cache.
up.mdlTrtMissing: This ONNX Runtime build has no TensorRT provider — the ONNX path works without it (AMD/Intel/CPU).
up.mdlTrtBusy: Building engine… this can take a few minutes
up.mdlTrtReused: Engine was already cached — loaded in {sec} s ({file})
up.mdlTrtAllHint: Build TensorRT engines for every downloaded upscaler: each engine compiles for minutes, then loads from cache. The ONNX file is removed afterwards to free disk space.
up.mdlBenchHint: Measure this model's speed on this machine: one tile is run several times and the best time is kept
up.mdlBenchAllHint: Run the benchmark for every downloaded model: the numbers stay on this computer and are yours alone
up.mdlBenchStopHint: Stop the benchmark series: the current model finishes, the next one does not start
up.mdlBenchClearHint: Delete the saved benchmark results (for example after changing the GPU or driver)
up.mdlBenchTip: Estimate for an 848×480 frame from {tiles} tiles · best of {runs} runs · {date}
up.mdlErr_bench_busy: a benchmark is already running — wait for it to finish
up.mdlTrtAllDone: Done: {built} of {total} engines built, {mb} MB freed
up.mdlOnnxDropHint: The engine is built, so the model file can leave the disk: on the next run it is downloaded again and the engine is taken from cache
up.mdlOnnxDroppedNote: ONNX removed, {mb} MB freed — the engine stays in cache
up.packHint: A custom ONNX runtime build with CUDA/TensorRT for NVIDIA GPUs: downloaded separately, the regular DirectML/CPU path works without it. This is an independent pack (CUDA 12.9) — not the same as the PyTorch build in Voice (CUDA 12.8) or whisper's CUDA build in Lecture (CUDA 11.8/12.4); they can't be merged, three different engines.
up.packRestart: Done — restart the app to apply
up.precisionHint: The model runs at the precision it was released with (usually FP32). The TensorRT provider compiles the graph for your GPU and supports FP16 — that is the precision control for NVIDIA. AMD, Intel and CPU use the regular ONNX path. FP8/INT8 are not supported: they need a separate calibration.

upSettings.modelHint: ONNX model used for new upscale jobs
upSettings.tileHint: 0 — auto; smaller tiles use less VRAM
